label: preparing
what: A bridge or port change proposal is being discussed/planned, apparently associated with the bakery. The account heard secondhand from Townsfolk 11 says the baker, innkeeper, and neighbour were present; innkeeper was mentioned repeatedly. Freight relayed the lighting appointment and bread delivery, not confirmed involvement in the proposal. Secretary reports no official proposal, so this is a private, unconfirmed preparation rather than an established town decision.
